reflection: I adjusted idea 1 to clarify that a more aggressive momentum (higher beta) is novel and better-targeted to the biggest miss, and that default mean ensemble is a meaningful change versus the champion. I replaced the leader model with a trend_tail approach (idea 5), as leader is expected to have impact on only a subset and trend_tail provides a more robust global fix for the most extreme failures in the worst series, something leader cannot target. All specs were double-checked for redundant or inoperative settings; all now have every parameter effective. Feasibility for all is 10 and they are not disguised repeats, and each idea is now closely tied to either the largest group miss or the single worst series.

reflection: All five ideas were checked for feasibility and each involves a parameter or model not previously used exactly in this ensemble. The group-hedge and momentum-k sweep were both rated higher for expected impact due to linkage with the top miss. Scores and descriptions were updated for clarity and consistency.

biggest_miss: By horizon: 7 days, y_above_q50 = 0.577, above_q90 = 0.364 (far too often under q50/q90 at long horizon)
reflection: All specs are valid and all parameter changes are effective—none are redundant. The first three ideas (per-series calibration, leading signals via leader, and group adaption by gpu_model) directly address major, persistent mis-calibration or skill gaps across horizons/groups, not single rare series. The provider-mix idea’s expected gain is a bit less direct for the 7-day horizon miss, but significant enough given the frequency of provider churn. The eta sweep could risk fitting to recent noise, yet evidence from DEV (momentum dominating some groups, insufficient reweighting) justifies a sweep. I slightly lower the eta sweep gain/novelty scores (gain: 6→5, novelty: 7→6) since a simple eta increase may not help if coverage error is structural. All other idea scores stand. No invalid or redundant specs or repeats found, so the batch is retained unmodified—with minor score adjustment for better realism.

reflection: All specs were checked and remain valid (all parameters have an effect). The scale and eta sweeps will reveal if moderate tuning or larger jumps help.
